text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Sepsis (likely Group B Streptococcus or E. coli) secondary to intrauterine chorioamnionitis, complicated by Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy and possible Intraventricular Hemorrhage.

I have noted the history of chorioamnionitis, low birth weight, and poor Apgar scores. I need to confirm if there are any signs of respiratory distress or jaundice. REQUEST TEST: CBC, Blood Culture, C-reactive protein (CRP). REQUEST IMAGES: Cranial_Ultrasound.
